_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_janis: The Inspection

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I'm here to inspect the workshop. Council protocol.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: The organization is... questionable. But the mech is adequate.

options.text: Adequate? It's the best mech in the region.
I'd be happy to walk you through the designs.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: ...You stood your ground. Most people defer to the Council pin.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Interesting. Perhaps Coppervale has more spine than I assumed.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I'll note that in my report. Favorably.
